scene: Across the bridge, a bustling rooftop transit depot awaits you.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a wide junction rooftop. On the far left, the rope suspension bridge ends. Near left, an open iron freight lift with an interior lever waits. The dark-haired boy in a denim jacket stands centre-left. In the centre, an electric golf-cart shuttle sits idling. On the right, a glowing night tram waits beside a ticket booth.
shown: a heavy iron freight lift with its accordion gate open on the left
a striped electric golf-cart shuttle idling in the centre
a glowing yellow night tram parked beside a platform on the right
